quote: Have no fear of perfection — you'll never reach it.

My feeling is that as far as creativity is concerned, isolation is
                            required. The creative person is, in any case, continually working at it. His mind is
                            shuffling his information at all times, even when he is not conscious of it. The presence of
                            others can only inhibit this process, since creation is embarrassing. For every new good
                            idea you have, there are a hundred, ten thousand foolish ones, which you naturally do not
                            care to display.
